title: Geography
description: ICSE Class IX Geography (H.C.G. Paper 2): one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 70 marks plus 30 marks internal assessment, including map work and a project.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Geography (H.C.G. Paper 2, www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Our World; The Earth's Structure (interior, rocks, weathering); Hydrosphere; Atmosphere; Pollution; Natural Regions of the World; Map Reading.

sections.title: Geography
sections.description: Seven units from the geographic grid to map reading, with 30 marks internal assessment.

chapters.title: Earth as a Planet
chapters.blurb: Shape and size of the earth, its position in the solar system, conditions that support life.

chapters.title: Latitudes and Longitudes: The Geographic Grid
chapters.blurb: Parallels and meridians, important latitudes, time zones and the International Date Line.

chapters.title: Maps and Their Uses
chapters.blurb: Types of maps, scale, direction, map elements and the interpretation of small-scale maps.

chapters.title: Interior of the Earth and Rocks
chapters.blurb: Crust, mantle and core; igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks and the rock cycle.

chapters.title: Weathering and Denudation
chapters.blurb: Physical, chemical and biological weathering, mass movement and agents of erosion.

chapters.title: Earthquakes and Volcanoes
chapters.blurb: Causes, distribution, effects and case examples of earthquakes and volcanic activity.

chapters.title: Hydrosphere: Oceans
chapters.blurb: Ocean relief, salinity, temperature, currents, tides and their importance.

chapters.title: Atmosphere
chapters.blurb: Composition and layers, insolation, pressure and winds, humidity and precipitation.

chapters.title: Pollution
chapters.blurb: Types, causes and effects of air, water, soil and noise pollution; remedies and citizen action.

chapters.title: Natural Regions of the World
chapters.blurb: Location, climate, vegetation and human adaptation across the major natural regions.

chapters.title: Map Reading
chapters.blurb: Contours, slopes, relief features, settlement and drainage interpretation, directions and bearings.
